name: CAP-U10PADREFIT1
question: Refit 1 of the fit pad, after round 1 in CAP-U10PADPREDICT.json scored 6 of 12. Five new Texts alone on Blocks Probe, each picked at two layouts.

rules.F: A fitted block takes the fewest rows n whose height, 41.09 x n - 11, holds its content height plus 33.5px (refit from 30: the pads that fit every single-block read so far, seen and round 1, run from 32.5 to 34.9). Section rows: the end line plus 3 (layout 2), 2 (layout 3) or 1 (layouts 4 and 5).
rules.C: New guess from round 1: at layout 2, a Text of headings only ends no later than line 11 (6 rows), even when its content needs more. Lists and quotes are not capped.

scoring: Per read: the block area and the section rows. contentH here is from ours, not scored. at25 and at36: the spans pads of 25 and 36 would give. H4 is picked at layout 5 first, so its layout 2 read tests whether the cap depends on the pick order. A Text split into two blocks counts as a miss.
score: Refit 1: 6 of 10 as predicted, frozen. Rule F (33.5px) predicted 8 reads: QW at 4 and 2, Q5 at 3 and 5, H4 at 5 and H6 at 3 as predicted; UL5 at 4 and 2 miss by one row because the oracle's 5-item list is 579 tall where ours is 571.8; on the read content height F gives the read span there too (8 of 8). Rule C (layout 2 caps headings at line 11) scored 0 of 2 and is dropped: H4 picked at layout 2 second fits by F (5/2/16/26, rows 19), and H6 picked at layout 2 first ends at line 6 (5/2/6/26, rows 9), shorter than both rules. Every fresh read puts the pad at 32.0 to 33.6.
